notes.title: The Lost Tape - Cellar Release
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, we are happy to announce that our next game, 'The Lost Tape - Cellar,' will be released soon. It is the first episode of a horror game series in VHS style.

We have watched every video that was posted about Forsaken Barn and read every comment. Thanks to your feedback, we were able to make our next game better.

We hope that most, if not all, of the issues that Forsaken Barn had have been resolved in this new game.

'The Lost Tape - Cellar' will be available on January 23, 2024. For now, you can check its store page and add it to your wishlist if the game interests you.

Thank you for your support on our game development journey.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2769310/The_Lost_Tape__Cellar/
